subject_template: Update regarding your application for {{job_title}} at AgentHire
body_template:
Dear {{candidate_name}},

Thank you for taking the time to apply for the {{job_title}} role at AgentHire and for sharing your background with us.

While your skills and experience are commendable, we have decided to move forward with candidates whose current profile more closely aligns with our specific requirements at this time.

We will keep your resume in our talent network for future opportunities that match your background.

We wish you the best in your career endeavors.

Warm regards,
AgentHire Recruiting Team
